t: This is Tudor Lodge, a nineteenth-century house and artist's studio in Camden Town. It was commissioned by the painter Charles Lucy, who lived from 1814 to 1873. Lucy was born in Hereford and studied at the École des Beaux-Arts and the Royal Academy. He painted historical scenes and portraits, and won prizes in competitions held during the rebuilding of the Houses of Parliament, though none of his works ended up displayed there. He also co-founded and taught at a drawing school in Camden Town.
